question: Find Melanoma trials with minimum follow‑up and show months by arm.

gemini.answer: This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, publication year, pubmed ID, and follow-up durations for the trials with the shortest overall follow-up duration for Melanoma.
gemini.raw:
```json
{
  "sql": "SELECT \"nct\", \"author\", \"year\", \"pubmed_id\", \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\", \"follow_up_duration_rx_months\", \"follow_up_duration_control_months\"\nFROM public.\"clinical_trials\"\nWHERE \"cancer_type\" ILIKE '%Melanoma%'\nORDER BY \"follow_up_duration_overall_months\" ASC\nLIMIT 10;",
  "answer": "This query retrieves the NCT ID, author, publication year, pubmed ID, and follow-up durations for the trials with the shortest overall follow-up duration for Melanoma.",
  "assumptions": ""
}
```
